current_store.transaction_scope: One full workspace record per read or write
current_store.database_upgrade_behavior: Creates workspace store if absent; no later upgrade path is currently defined

fallback_store.selection_rule: loadProjectWorkspace compares IndexedDB and fallback persistence revisions, then committed timestamps
fallback_store.write_rule: IndexedDB is attempted first; localStorage is written only when IndexedDB write fails
fallback_store.cleanup_rule: A successful IndexedDB write removes an older fallback record when it is not newer

behavior: Choose newest persistence revision, then committed timestamp
Fall back to a default workspace when neither candidate is usable
Serialize writes through a promise queue
read_write_paths.debounce_owner: App.jsx, approximately 500ms after hydrated state changes

read_write_paths.behavior: Appends a new scenario snapshot with a new id and timestamps; it does not update an existing scenario revision
Exports or imports a bounded JSON project envelope; imported project and scenario ids are regenerated

compaction_rules: Only the newest five scenarios retain artifacts.
Older scenario artifacts are set to null and requiresRerun becomes true.
Recommendation GeoJSON properties are compacted to id-only properties.
Invalid projects/scenarios are filtered during normalization.

durable_across_reload: Selected cached result artifacts, subject to compaction
recomputed_or_ephemeral: Path/reference diagnostics not included in scenario artifacts
UI selection, drawer, map, and notification state
Backend job/cache maps after process restart
conditionally_durable: Simulation, gap, interference, and network artifacts when planDirty is false and the scenario is among the five retained artifact scenarios
Measurement analysis summary; raw measurement samples and provenance are not included in the current scenario snapshot

risk_register.risk: The entire workspace is one opaque record, so a single write serializes all projects, scenarios, and retained artifacts.
risk_register.impact: Large writes, coarse conflict granularity, and difficult future multi-device synchronization.
risk_register.mitigation: Keep IndexedDB as local-first storage now; introduce a repository boundary and normalized domain model before any server migration.

risk_register.risk: Persistence revision is process-local and has no server or device identity.
risk_register.impact: Revision ordering is useful for local fallback recovery but is not a distributed conflict protocol.
risk_register.mitigation: Future sync needs stable entity revisions, device/outbox metadata, and explicit conflict policy.

risk_register.risk: Saved scenario artifacts are caches rather than complete run evidence.
risk_register.impact: Reload can require rerun, and current snapshots do not prove the exact engine/dataset environment.
risk_register.mitigation: Persist immutable Run metadata and provenance separately before treating results as audit-grade.

risk_register.risk: Project-local tower snapshots conflate reusable inventory with scenario overrides.
risk_register.impact: A cell edit is difficult to reuse or reconcile across scenarios.
risk_register.mitigation: Concept 7B defines Inventory and ScenarioOverride boundaries without changing current behavior.

risk_register.risk: There is no orphan cleanup or per-entity delete protocol because records are nested in one envelope.
risk_register.impact: Logical deletion is safe locally but future partial sync needs tombstones or revision-aware operations.
risk_register.mitigation: Define deletion and retention semantics in the repository contract before server persistence.

audit_conclusion: IndexedDB is sufficient for the current single-user, local-first workspace and should remain in place for the next release. It is not sufficient as a durable shared source of truth for projects, runs, large geospatial data, or immutable evidence.
